info.title: kicadsharp
info.description:
A dotnet tool for working with KiCad's s-expression files from the command line:
summarise a file's structure, reformat it through a lossless parse/write round trip, read a value by
path, and validate that a file parses. Installs as `kicadsharp`.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Work with KiCad's s-expression files: summarise their structure, reformat them through a parse/write round trip, read a value by path, and check that they parse.

commands.name: parse
commands.description: Parse a file and print a structural summary: form count, top-level heads, node and value counts, depth.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit the summary as JSON instead of a table. [default: False]

commands.name: fmt
commands.description: Round-trip a file through the parser and the writer. The result is verified by re-parsing it and comparing the trees, so this is also the proof that the round trip is lossless.

options.name: --in-place
options.description: Rewrite the file instead of printing to stdout. [default: False]

commands.name: query
commands.description: Read a value out of a file by path.

options.name: --all
options.description: Print every match instead of only the first. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Dotted or slashed path, e.g. 'kicad_sch.version' or 'kicad_sch/symbol[2]/property'. A segment names a child token; '[n]' picks the zero-based nth match.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Check that a file is structurally sound and that the parser accepts it. Exits non-zero when it is not.
